Subject: Your aircraft lease repossession matter (Project Heron)

Dear Ms. Kulkarni,

Thank you for meeting us on 21 April 2021 about your dispute with Everest Airways Ltd. As we understand it, the airline sought protection from its creditors.

Our advice is to argue that leased aircraft fall outside the insolvency moratorium. Please collect the lease agreement and the moratorium order and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
